fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Character / class master table (806 rows x 908 bytes). One row per unique character form, per generic class TIER (6 rows per class, ids family*10+0..5), per NPC and per map object. Key = id (+0xD0). Links: learnset -> magic.dat, evility1/2 -> Skill.dat, overload_id -> OverlordSkill.dat, help_id -> charhelp.dat, sprite_id -> anmNNNNN, magichange_weapon -> item.dat, voice_id -> charPersonal voice_group (/10) and Sound_Voice. Class-family ids (tier 0 ids: 10..990 uniques, 1010..1350 human classes, 2010..2330 monster classes) index comb.dat; tier rows are chained by JobRank.dat. Row layout: stats/learnset/evility block 0x000-0x0F7, 5x name (0x34), 5x title (0x44), aptitudes/masteries/resistances/misc 0x350-0x38B. Reserved empty class slots: Human Dummy rows (ids 1270-1355) and Monster Dummy rows (2220-2335).

fields.name: immunity_flags
fields.desc: bitmask, 0 for almost everyone; bosses: 127 (Bloodis, Void Dark, Liezerota Dark, Prinny Overlord), 16383 (Killidia), -1 (Dark, Baal, Ball Bits). Probably ailment/effect immunity bits (not verified which bit = which ailment).

fields.name: base_HP
fields.desc: base stat (level-1 value before aptitude); order HP SP ATK DEF INT RES HIT SPD. Verified: Magician INT>ATK, Red Magnus HP 42, generic tiers +2/+1 per tier.

fields.name: learn1_skill
fields.desc: learnset: skill/spell id (magic.dat key) learned at learn<N>_level; slots beyond learn_count are 0. 1xxxx = unique/class skills, 2xxxx = Magichange skills, 3xxxx = combo skills, <10000 = generic spells (Fire 9001, Heal 1401 ...)

fields.name: learn1_level
fields.desc: level at which learn<N>_skill is learned (1..9999; 10000 seen = effectively never / special unlock)

fields.name: learn_count
fields.desc: number of used learn slots (0..16); slots >= count are zero

fields.name: pad_076
fields.desc: always zero (66 bytes); maybe spare learnset space

fields.name: evility1
fields.desc: innate (unique/class) Evility, Skill.dat id. Killia 10 War Demon, Seraphina 40, Warrior 1010 Wild Cry, Prinny 2010 Explosive Body; generic classes use their class-family id; 0 = none

fields.name: evility2
fields.desc: second innate Evility (only main story cast: Killia 11, Seraphina 41, Red Magnus 51, Christo 61, Usalia 71, Zeroken 101 ...), else 0

fields.name: evility3
fields.desc: always 0 - presumed further innate Evility slot

fields.name: evility4
fields.desc: always 0 - presumed further innate Evility slot

fields.name: evility_count
fields.desc: number of innate evilities: the engine uses evility1..evility<N> and ignores the rest (0x1402c0040 loops over byte +0xC8). Equals the number of non-zero evility fields on every vanilla row; the kit sets it automatically for modded characters. (Called story_flag before.)

fields.name: unk_0CA
fields.desc: group id 100..189 shared by visually related characters: 100 = Killia/dummies/misc, 101 Seraphina, 102 Red Magnus, 103 Christo, 104 Usalia+family+Yellow Prinny, 105 Zeroken, 117..142 = the human classes in order (Warrior 117 .. Sorcerer 189 for DLC classes 187-189), 140 Prinny (+helper Prinnies), 141 Imp .. 160 Horseman, 161..186 DLC guest characters; NPCs share their class group (e.g. Memoria=Witch 120). 0 for objects/NPCs without. Not an anm id and not a charhelp id; maybe a cut-in/motion/effect set.

fields.name: overload_id
fields.desc: Overload (unique special) id, OverlordSkill.dat key: Killia 1, Seraphina 2, Red Magnus 4, Christo 6, Usalia 8, Zeroken 9, Majorita 11/12, Void Dark 13, Void 19, Dark 20, story Overlords 100..114, DLC guests 200..213; 0 = none

fields.name: id
fields.desc: unique character id (KEY, referenced by comb.dat, JobRank.dat, Quest rewards, zukan.dat, DLC delivery, Enemy_Create_Table...). Uniques: multiples of 10 (Killia 10, Seraphina 40 ...); generic classes: family*10 + tier (Warrior 1010..1015, Prinny 2010..2015); shop NPCs 3000-4999, objects 5000+

fields.name: sprite_id
fields.desc: battle sprite = anm%05d file in ANM_HI_* (anmNNN0 main, anmNNN1 companion file). All tiers of a class share it (Warrior 1010); variant forms may borrow another sprite (Void Dark? rows use Chimera 2150 / Imp 2020). Dummies point to non-existent 1270..

fields.name: size_radius
fields.desc: 5..21: grows with body size (Prinny 5, humans 6, Bear 8, Dragon 9, Horseman 12, Proto Darkdeath 18, UFO 21). Probably shadow/footprint size

fields.name: height
fields.desc: unit height (Prinny 11, humans 14, Succubus 17, Tree 38, Pillar 36) - probably used for lift/tower/marker placement

fields.name: height2
fields.desc: second height value, usually = height but larger for tall heads/ears (Usalia 20, Red Magnus 17, Dark 17) - probably HP bar/marker position

fields.name: help_id
fields.desc: charhelp.dat id of the description shown in status/encyclopedia (all tiers share the family help; Seraphina Bunny Girl uses 40). 100% of values exist in charhelp.dat

fields.name: color_id
fields.desc: look/palette variant: for classes = sprite_id + tier (Warrior 1010..1015 -> tier palettes), special forms sprite+n (2158, 2027); objects = own id; 9999 ship parts. Probably selects palette/appearance record

fields.name: unk_0E0
fields.desc: 3..9: class grade-like value, constant over tiers for most classes (Warrior/Magician/Cleric 4, Thief/Archer/Gunner/Ninja 5, Samurai/Armor Knight/Magic Knight/Professor 6, Pirate/Sage/Dark Knight 7) but Asagi class 3..8 by tier, Item God 9. Unknown

fields.name: MOV
fields.desc: Move range (Killia 5, Seraphina 4, Warrior 4, Thief/Ninja/Zeroken 6, objects 0)

fields.name: move_type
fields.desc: 0 normal; 1 flying/floating units (Imp, Fairy, Winged Warrior, Succubus, Sea Angel, Nine-Tails, Celestial Host/Hostess, Majorita, Void Dark, Dark Bit, Level Fish, Horseman); 2 = Bits

fields.name: attack_range
fields.desc: probably normal-attack range: 1 for most, 2-4 for magic monsters (Succubus 4, Nine-Tails/Chimera/Sea Angel 3), Baal 9, Bottlemail 0

fields.name: hl_value
fields.desc: HL reward base when defeated: Lucky Board "HL Man" 2000/"HL Prince" 7500, Thief 150..200, most 10..65

fields.name: exp_value
fields.desc: EXP reward base when defeated: Lucky Board "EXP Man" 200/"EXP Prince" 750, generic tiers 20..25

fields.name: unk_0EC
fields.desc: % value, 100 for most; Killia 130, Bear 150, Bloodis 165, Liezerota Dark 300, Lucky Boards 500, Christo 75, Armor Knight 60, Celestial Host 50, objects/Bottlemail 0. Maybe Revenge-gauge gain rate

fields.name: unk_0EE
fields.desc: 10 for uniques; generic tiers 10,13,16,19,22,25 (+3 per tier), Asagi 14..29, Item God 55. Unknown (reward/level related)

fields.name: mana_value
fields.desc: Mana-related value: Lucky Board "Mana Man" 2000/"Mana Prince" 7500; generic tiers 100,85,70,55,40,25 (Prinny 200..125). Likely Mana reward base (or Mana gain rate)

fields.name: dlc_group
fields.desc: 100 = base game; 110/120/130/140/150 = DLC content packs (Disgaea 1 / D4 / D3 / D2 / other guest characters and the DLC classes Celestial Hostess 110, Kunoichi 120, Sorcerer 130)

fields.name: magichange_weapon
fields.desc: item.dat id of the weapon this unit becomes when Magichanging (Prinny 251 "Prinny Sword", Sludge 151 "Gel Gloves", Desco 5351 "Desco Sword"); 0 = cannot Magichange (443 on monster dummies = invalid)

fields.name: voice_id
fields.desc: voice/sound set: Sound_Voice ids are (voice_id/10)*100000+n; charPersonal voice_group = voice_id/10 for generics (Warrior 1010 -> 101). Variant forms reuse (Dark Killia 30 = Killidia, helper Prinnies 2010); objects 5100.. (break sounds)

fields.name: name_JP
fields.desc: character name (generic classes: class name, e.g. "Warrior")

fields.name: title_JP
fields.desc: title / class-rank name shown under the name (Killia "Wanderer", Warrior tiers "Fighter".."Battle Master")

fields.name: apt_HP
fields.desc: aptitude % per stat (HP SP ATK DEF INT RES HIT SPD); Killia ATK 125, Magician INT 120, tiers +5 every 2 tiers

fields.name: mastery_fist
fields.desc: weapon-mastery aptitude per weapon type (Fist Sword Spear Bow Gun Axe Staff MonsterPhys MonsterMag); humans have 0 for monster weapons, monsters 0 for human weapons. Verified: Archer Bow 20, Gunner Gun 20, Magician Staff 16, Martial Artist Fist 16

fields.name: mastery_armor
fields.desc: 10th value in the mastery block: 10 typical, Armor Knight 18..23, Dark Knight 15..20, Horseman 14..19, Wrestler 4..6, grows with tier. Probably armor mastery/aptitude (HABIT.dat equip order is weapons.., Armor ...)

fields.name: res_fire
fields.desc: elemental resistance % (signed) Fire Wind Ice Star: Magician +25/+25/+25/0, Sludge -75 x4, Dragon King fire +50, Sea Angel fire -75

fields.name: wres_fist
fields.desc: weapon-type resistance % (signed) vs attacks of Fist Sword Spear Bow Gun Axe Staff Monster (D5 "weapon resistance"): Armor Knight +30/+30/+20/+20/+20/-20/-40/-30, Sludge resists physical but weak to staff, Bottlemail +50 all, Lucky Board -25 all. Correlates with own weapon mastery (r 0.4-0.8)

fields.name: kind_gender
fields.desc: tens digit = kind (0 unique/special/object, 1 generic human class, 2 generic monster class), ones digit = gender (1 male, 2 female, 3 none: talk-check dummies). Human Dummy rows are 12, monster dummies 21/22

fields.name: tier
fields.desc: class tier / rank index 0..5 (Fighter 0 .. Battle Master 5); other values (up to 9) used by enemy-only variants (Bottlemail/Lucky Board/Proto Darkdeath levels, Void Dark? 7/8)

fields.name: pad_37A
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: unk_37B
fields.desc: always 10

fields.name: JMP
fields.desc: Jump height (Killia 20, Seraphina 15, Magician 15, Thief 25, Ninja 30, Kunoichi/Rabbit/Winged 35, Level Fish 64)

fields.name: throw
fields.desc: Throw distance (Logan the "Throwing Overlord" 7, Bear 7, Killia 5, Magician 3, objects 0)

fields.name: counter
fields.desc: Counter count (Martial Artist/Fight Mistress 4, Zeroken/Ninja/Wrestler 3, Killia 2, Magician/Maid 0)

fields.name: unk_37F
fields.desc: 0 objects/Baal, 1 default, 2 melee classes (Killia, Warrior, Valkyrie, Martial Artist, Lady Samurai, Magic Knight, Wrestler, Dark Knight, Rabbit, Laharl ...), 3 Maid, Armor Knight, Red Magnus, Bloodis, Goldion, Fenrich. Unknown

fields.name: crit
fields.desc: 0..20, grows slowly with tier (Warrior 5-6, Thief 9-11, Ninja/Kunoichi/Fuka 15, Asagi 12, objects 0). Probably base critical rate %

fields.name: unk_381
fields.desc: category 0..9 per class (Warrior 1, Magician 2, Martial Artist 6, Clergy 7, Maid/Wrestler 9 ...). Unknown (personality / interrogation type?)

fields.name: unk_382
fields.desc: 1 only for Magician & Witch tiers and NPCs using those sprites (Manari, Shrimp, Memoria); sprite/motion flag?

fields.name: magichange_type
fields.desc: weapon type of the Magichange weapon (1 Fist 2 Sword 3 Spear 4 Bow 5 Gun 6 Axe 7 Staff) = first digit of magichange_weapon; 0 = none

fields.name: unk_384
fields.desc: 1 = uniques + special enemies (Bottlemail, Lucky Board, Mr. Egg), 2 = generic classes, NPC shopkeepers, objects

fields.name: unk_385
fields.desc: 0 except Lost Officer = 2

fields.name: body_type
fields.desc: 0 humanoid, 1 monster-type (monster classes, Christo, Usalia, story monsters; all Magichange users), 2 object

fields.name: pad_387
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: unk_388
fields.desc: 1 for scenery objects (cactus, tables, pillars, mushrooms, item symbols...), 0 otherwise (incl. boxes/barrels/bombs)

fields.name: pad_389
fields.desc: always 0

fields.name: is_dummy_slot
fields.desc: 1 = reserved empty class slot ("Human Dummy" ids 1270-1355, "Monster Dummy" 2220-2335), 0 otherwise

fields.name: pad_38B
fields.desc: always 0
